criteria_review.expected_description: Store owners and sales personnel create products.

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.

criterion.given: A user with Store owner or Sales personnel role
criterion.when: they save a new product definition
criterion.then: the system stores the product record

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.

criteria_review.explanation: Actor, action and observable result cover this requirement.

criteria_review.expected_description: Store owners and sales personnel create customer accounts.

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.

criterion.given: A user with Store owner or Sales personnel role
criterion.when: they save a new customer account
criterion.then: the system creates the customer record

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.

criteria_review.explanation: Actor, action and observable result cover this requirement.

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel should be able to manage products and customer accounts, while customers should be able to browse the available products, maintain a shopping cart, and place orders through the store.

criterion.when: they navigate to the product catalog
criterion.then: the system displays the available products

source.quote: customers should be able to browse the available products

criteria_review.explanation: Actor, action and observable result cover this requirement.

criteria_review.expected_description: Customers add available products to the cart.

source.quote: Customers can add available products to the cart, change quantities to positive whole numbers, and remove items.

criterion.given: A product exists in the catalog
criterion.then: the item is added to the customer's cart

source.quote: Customers can add available products to the cart

criteria_review.explanation: Given only says product exists, not that it is available. Selecting a product is treated as adding it, although the source defines an add action rather than a selection interaction.

criteria_review.expected_description: Successful submission creates one order with selected items and quantities.

source.quote: A successful submission creates one order containing the selected items and quantities and displays its reference.

criterion.given: A customer has items in the cart
criterion.then: the system creates one order containing selected items and quantities

source.quote: A successful submission creates one order containing the selected items and quantities and displays its reference.

criteria_review.explanation: The successful-order criterion has a nonempty cart but does not explicitly require a signed-in customer. AC7 addresses sign-in separately; cross-criterion consistency still needs review.

criteria_review.expected_description: Customers may browse without signing in.

source.quote: Customers may browse without signing in but must sign in before placing an order.

criterion.given: A customer is not signed in
criterion.when: the customer accesses the product list
criterion.then: the system displays the list without requiring credentials

source.quote: Customers may browse without signing in

criteria_review.explanation: Actor, action and observable result cover this requirement.

criteria_review.expected_description: Customers must sign in before order placement.

source.quote: Customers may browse without signing in but must sign in before placing an order.

criterion.given: A customer has items in the cart
criterion.when: the customer attempts to place an order without a valid session
criterion.then: the system forces a sign-in process

source.quote: must sign in before placing an order.

criteria_review.explanation: Forcing a sign-in process is observable but the outcome does not assert that no order is placed before successful sign-in.

criteria_review.expected_description: Customers change cart quantities to positive whole numbers.

source.quote: Customers can add available products to the cart, change quantities to positive whole numbers, and remove items.

criterion.given: A customer has an item in the cart with quantity 1
criterion.when: the customer updates the quantity to 5

source.quote: change quantities to positive whole numbers

criteria_review.explanation: Quantity 5 is accepted, but zero, negative and fractional inputs are not checked. This is incomplete coverage, not a newly invented rule.

source.quote: Customers can add available products to the cart, change quantities to positive whole numbers, and remove items.

criterion.given: A customer has an item in the cart
criterion.then: the item is no longer in the cart

source.quote: remove items

criteria_review.explanation: Actor, action and observable result cover this requirement.

criteria_review.expected_description: Store owners and sales personnel update products.

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.

criterion.when: a Store owner updates the product attributes
criterion.then: the system updates the product record

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.

criteria_review.explanation: Only Store owner is tested for product update; Sales personnel is also authorized by the requirement.

criteria_review.expected_description: Store owners and sales personnel update customer accounts.

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.

criterion.when: a Sales personnel updates the account details
criterion.then: the system updates the customer record

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.

criteria_review.explanation: Only Sales personnel is tested for account update; Store owner is also authorized by the requirement.

criteria_review.expected_description: Successful submission displays its order reference.

source.quote: A successful submission creates one order containing the selected items and quantities and displays its reference.

criterion.then: the system displays a unique order reference

source.quote: displays its reference.

criteria_review.explanation: The output adds unique and reference number wording; the source only requires displaying its reference. When the order is processed may move display later than successful submission.

criteria_review.expected_description: Reject empty-cart submission without creating an order.

source.quote: An empty cart cannot be submitted.

criterion.then: the system rejects the submission and does not create an order

source.quote: An empty cart cannot be submitted.

criteria_review.explanation: Actor, action and observable result cover this requirement.

task_behavior_review.confirmed_additions: Tasks are split from two broad items into five product/account/browse/cart/order items, retaining the supplied create/update scope, guest browsing, cart operations and sign-in before ordering.
task_behavior_review.unsupported_crud_or_cart_registration: No added delete capability or mandatory cart registration found in this output.
task_behavior_review.reference_wording: TASK5 says reference number; source only says reference. This may incorrectly imply numeric format.
